description: This file defines the 'Config' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing configuration entries stored in the database. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping, with private properties for name and value, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Entity class for configuration entries in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'hs_hr_config' table via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration setting.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the configuration setting.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the configuration setting.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the configuration setting.
